title: Wait for agent readiness before sending the round-1 brief
action: Per D1: after agent_start succeeds, poll agent readiness (agent_status idle-or-equivalent; honor interactive_ready when the Herdr impl exposes it — extend the trait minimally if needed, updating FakeHerdr/PanicHerdr) with the existing injected-clock seam, bounded by a 60s ready-wait; then agent_prompt the brief. Exhaustion = typed SpawnFailed keeping the pane. Tests: brief prompt happens only after readiness flips; exhaustion path keeps the pane and names ready-wait in the message.

truths: No brief prompt before the agent reports ready
Ready-wait exhaustion is a typed failure that keeps the pane
